entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • "dotnet run --no-restore --no-build --no-launch-profile" significantly slower than "dotnet exec <path-to-dll>" #51460
  • [NETSDKE2E][Windows]With 10.0.100 SDK installed on windows, error "Workload installation failed: Failed to install 814fe26b23c58be5f7a479ed4eab816c-x64.msi. Error: 0x00000643, Fatal error during installation." happens after running "dotnet workload install maui" in CLI #51459

Closed

  • [NetTestingE2E][Regression] Error "The library hostfxr.dll was found..." will throw when executing "dotnet test --arch x86 --diag:log1.txt". #49436
  • Output from publishing file-based app using web SDK is included by default items, causes errors on subsequent publish #51391
    10.0.2xx

PullRequests

Created

  • Ensure that `--nologo` adheres to DOTNET_NOLOGO if present #51462

Merged

  • Add CA1876 analyzer to detect misuse of AsParallel() in foreach loops #51287
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Add CA1830 analyzer for StringBuilder.Append(new string(char, int)) #51215
  • [clr-ios] Support targeting Apple mobile platforms with CoreCLR #51429

Updated

  • Update versions .props based on the RC2 build #51414
  • Add source package for file-based programs support #51373
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Respond to `dnup` feedback from prototype code review #51446
  • Make S.CL builder DSLs more transferable #50685
    Area-CLI
  • dnup code review #50988
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add CA1876: Collapse nested Path.Combine/Path.Join calls #51456
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Extend CA1516 analyzer to detect cross-platform intrinsics methods with correct semantics #51455
  • Add automation for merging dnup to release/dnup #51447
  • Add CA2027: Detect non-cancelable Task.Delay in Task.WhenAny #51452
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Add CA2026 to rules missing documentation #51451
  • Improve clarity of 'dotnet project convert' output directory prompt #51443
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #51250
    Area-Containers, Branch Lockdown
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51376

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2825254 #51419
